name: Amamiya Mizuho
source:
Likes: Cooking, drinking alcohol.

Mizuho is a staff manager at "Burger Wack". She may appear to be graceful at first glance, but she also can say harsh things from time to time. Mizuho has a moody personality and she always acts at her own pace. She has a relaxed atmosphere of an adult which temporizes conversations. She also gives out a strange feeling.

[Translated from [url=http://memoriesoff.jp/psp/5/chara.html]the official site[/url].]
